title: Displaying Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories On The Homepage

## Displaying Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories On The Homepage
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000021788
This guide demonstrates the setup utilizing the Streaming Top Categories widget. For displaying lower-tier categories on the homepage, select the Streaming Sub Level Categories widget instead. The configuration steps for both options remain identical.
To display Top-Level Categories on the homepage, navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage tab >> Select Streaming Top Categories option under Select Content to Display section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090675822/original/64oL48sAC_D4vEl_rP0L86a4gJafdjMFaw.png?1617115357 | alt: ]
Clicking on Edit Settings will display a module where this widget can be edited further:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090676021/original/3qYxyCt2H6vLajHsGy-xdI-WED2ojvdejw.png?1617115505 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090676049/original/GijjW8-zh9vwrjC5BVC64rHMj0EEGiCiXw.png?1617115528 | alt: ]
The next step would be adding related images to each categories.
Navigation Path: My Members » Member Categories
Navigation Path: My Members » Member Categories
Image Requirement: Upload a specific image to each category row.
Image Requirement: Upload a specific image to each category row.
Recommended Image Dimensions: 400px by 200px.
Recommended Image Dimensions: 400px by 200px.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093196356/original/Pa7Y3ieiYY_rl2UuZscYlQjOH-N6AqsuAg.png?1622058779 | alt: ]
Inside the Edit Settings module for the streaming widget, the visibility of the categories is determined by the following rule:
Enabled ("Only Show Categories with Photos"): The homepage widget will automatically hide any category that lacks an uploaded image.
Enabled ("Only Show Categories with Photos"): The homepage widget will automatically hide any category that lacks an uploaded image.
Disabled ("Only Show Categories with Photos"): All selected categories will display on the homepage, regardless of whether a placeholder image has been uploaded.
Disabled ("Only Show Categories with Photos"): All selected categories will display on the homepage, regardless of whether a placeholder image has been uploaded.
